nativeSemantics.colors: SwiftUI primary, secondary, accentColor, orange, red, green; NSColor.windowBackgroundColor and bar material
nativeSemantics.typography: System title2, title3, headline and callout; monospaced hashes and tabular digits
nativeSemantics.controls: Native TabView, GroupBox, Picker, Button, ProgressView and NSOpenPanel
nativeSemantics.preview: Native components have no HTML/CSS rendering equivalent in this sidecar.

narrative.overview: An expert desktop utility with explicit device and image identities, readable evidence and a deliberate write boundary. Use macOS conventions and factual status rather than decorative instrumentation. Technical detail belongs in the manifest and activity views, close to the claims it supports.
keyCharacteristics: an activity ledger driven by actual backend events
dos: Do keep source, target, record destination and write consequences inspectable.
Do preserve native keyboard focus, disabled states, semantic colors and selectable evidence.
Do label synthetic previews explicitly and keep them outside shipping code.
donts: Don't equate 100% writing or USB reconnection with successful completion.
Don't imply whole-file hash admission, authenticity, automatic resume or recovery guarantees.
Don't replace real backend phases with timers, guessed completion or decorative motion.
